title: Vitest for React: Component, Hook, and Integration Testing
title_es: Vitest en React: tests de componentes, hooks e integración
description: Runnable Vitest + React Testing Library project: jsdom setup, component and form tests, renderHook with act and fake timers, module and partial mocks, MSW 2.x network interception, snapshots, a checkout integration test, and CI coverage thresholds.
description_es: Proyecto ejecutable de Vitest + React Testing Library: setup con jsdom, tests de componentes y formularios, renderHook con act y fake timers, mocks de módulos y parciales, interceptación de red con MSW 2.x, snapshots, un test de integración de checkout y thresholds de cobertura en CI.
